name: Field
description: Field namespace: `<Field label …>` plus the parts for custom layouts.
signature: ({ label, description, hint, error, warning, counter, optional, required, aside, orientation, nativeLabel, legend, message, invalid, className, children, ...rest }: FieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aside
props.description: Right side of the label row: a live value readout or a small link.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: counter
props.description: Right side of the message line: `{ value: 70, max: 500 }` renders "70 / 500".

props.name: description
props.description: Second line under the label in a horizontal field ("Automatically download…").

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint in place. Setting it marks the field and its control invalid.

props.name: hint
props.description: The message line's resting text. Only when the format or consequence is not obvious (R2.8).

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Omit only when a group legend or `aria-label` names it instead.

props.name: legend
props.description: A heading above a horizontal field ("Auto-updates"). Renders a fieldset legend.

props.name: message
props.description:
reserve: the message line always exists (default for vertical fields), so an error
never moves anything (R9.1). auto: only rendered when there is a hint, error or counter.

props.name: nativeLabel
props.description:
Render the label as a native <label>. Set false for trigger controls (select,
combobox trigger, slider, segmented) so clicking the label focuses instead of activating.

props.name: optional
props.description: Marks the label "Optional". Prefer this over marking required fields.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
vertical: label above the control (text fields, selects).
horizontal: control first, label and description beside it (switches, checkboxes).

props.name: required
props.description: Shows the required marker. Pass `required` to the control as well.

props.name: warning
props.description: Non-blocking warning in the reserved message slot; errors take precedence.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `validate`: Validates the field when called.

props.name: dirty
props.description:
Whether the field's value has been changed from its initial value.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
Takes precedence over the `disabled` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.

props.name: invalid
props.description:
Whether the field is invalid.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

props.name: name
props.description:
Identifies the field when a form is submitted.
Takes precedence over the `name` prop on the `<Field.Control>` component.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: touched
props.description:
Whether the field has been touched.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

props.name: validate
props.type: ((value: unknown, formValues: Form.Values) => string | string[] | null | void | Promise<string | string[] | null | void>) | undefined
props.description:
A function for custom validation. Return a string or an array of strings with
the error message(s) if the value is invalid. Returning nothing, `null`, an empty
string, or an empty array means the value is valid.
Asynchronous functions are supported, but they do not prevent form submission
when using `validationMode="onSubmit"`.

props.name: validationDebounceTime
props.description:
How long to wait between `validate` callbacks if
`validationMode="onChange"` is used. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: validationMode
props.description:
Determines when the field should be validated.
This takes precedence over the `validationMode` prop on `<Form>`.

- `onSubmit`: triggers validation when the form is submitted, and re-validates on change after submission.
- `onBlur`: triggers validation when the control loses focus.
- `onChange`: triggers validation on every change to the control value.
